artboards.title: The shell — the drawing is the screen; one bar, panels folded, a right-click menu open
The estate stop — sites placed by hand, links as counted bundles, the tree open from the path
Two lenses over the same rack — Cables and Routing; nothing moved, only the marks changed
Optics — a cage takes an optic before it takes a cable; drag cage to cage and say what is between
Tracked changes — a maintenance record's changes shown on the drawing, the way a document shows them

annotations.text:
The shell, 2026-09-16. A proposal: four kinds of thing and nothing else gets a name.

Places: Racks and Inventory. Stops: estate, site, building, closet, rack, faceplate, inside. Lenses: Cables, Links, Routing, Power, Owner. Surfaces: the editor, search, the patching table, the walkthrough.

Row 1: the shell at the closet stop, and the estate stop with the tree open.
Row 2: two lenses over one rack, and optics.
Row 3: tracked changes.

Nothing here moves. The earlier sets already show the motion.

Not redrawn, because it is already drawn: inside a box (the approved Hypervisor and Firewall boards), the patching table, undo, the maintenance record, people, the operator console, walkthrough, inventory and home (the screens set of 2026-09-15).
Every name, site, circuit ID, address, count and time on these boards is a sample. Counts, models and positions in the product come from the graph and the catalogue and are never typed.
